purpose: Observed work evidence for P0 measurement.

records.basis: Implemented deterministic strict evidence validator and five focused acceptance/rejection tests; run start is automation-observed and end is GitHub commit-observed. No time outside these observed boundaries is counted.

Diagnosed CI as enforcing retired quarter-hour controls, replaced it with rolling-runtime/P0 invariants, added WORK_EVIDENCE audit and unit-test execution, then removed a failing checkout dependency. Boundaries are adjacent observed GitHub commits.

Hardened promotion logic so a 900-second window cannot be rejected or promoted before its observation horizon has actually completed; added explicit WINDOW_NOT_YET_COMPLETE regression coverage. Start is observed plan-progress boundary and end is observed implementation/test commit boundary.

Added timestamp-derived observed_seconds integrity checking, horizon clipping, mandatory unique record identity enforcement, and focused regression coverage. Both interval boundaries are observed GitHub commit timestamps; no surrounding work time is inferred.

Corrected fixed-window promotion so globally visible malformed evidence wholly outside the evaluated 900-second candidate does not poison that candidate, while invalid evidence intersecting the candidate remains fail-closed. Added focused regression coverage. Both boundaries are observed GitHub commit timestamps; no surrounding time is inferred.

Changed utilization coverage and gap accounting to use the merged union of clipped valid intervals while preserving explicit overlap rejection, then added a focused regression proving overlapping evidence cannot double-count reported useful_seconds. Both boundaries are observed GitHub commit timestamps; no surrounding time is inferred.

Implemented deterministic epoch-anchored 900-second fixed-window enumeration, then closed the caller-arbitrary-boundary loophole by rejecting promotion for non-fixed window starts; added focused enumeration, exact-boundary, and arbitrary-boundary regression tests. Both boundaries are observed GitHub commit timestamps; no surrounding time is inferred.

Canonicalized fixed 900-second measurement buckets to UTC so equivalent instants expressed with different offsets cannot enumerate different candidate-window strings, and added offset-invariance regression coverage. Both boundaries are observed GitHub commit timestamps; no surrounding time is inferred.

Implemented deterministic evaluation of completed canonical fixed windows, requiring an unbroken streak of at least three VALID_ACCEPTED windows before computing the selected rolling mean, and added PASS plus broken-streak regression coverage. Boundaries are observed GitHub commit timestamps; no surrounding time is inferred.

Made accepted fixed-window streak selection deterministic: freshest longest streak wins and streaks longer than required select the freshest required windows; added four-window and equal-length-streak regression coverage. Both boundaries are observed GitHub commit timestamps; no surrounding time is inferred.

Diagnosed the epoch-43 freshness gap as missing explicit capture rather than validator failure, implemented a deterministic non-inferential append helper with overlap/duplicate/timestamp guards, added focused tests, wired those tests into integrated CI, and made forward capture a worker responsibility. Start is the automation-observed turn boundary and end is the observed AGENTS policy commit boundary; no later time is counted.

Produced a strict baseline and ranked cause analysis, advanced work-spec acceptance from measured evidence, hardened the append path against backward authority epochs with regression coverage, and made current work evidence mandatory on wake. Boundaries are adjacent observed durable commits; no time after 15:54:39 is counted.

Added non-inferential evidence freshness summarization and tests, advanced NOW/project roll-up to retest state, documented strict capture semantics, and observed integrated control-plane CI success at 15:56:19 KST. Boundaries are adjacent observed durable events; no later time is counted.

Detected and corrected a control contradiction: the rolling lifecycle and hardcoded bounded-turn protocol require verified same-canonical continuation at bounded close, while the gate previously allowed end only after successor observation/handoff. Added explicit bounded-close requirements and verified both continuation-policy and integrated control-plane CI green at 15:57:58 KST.

Consolidated the observed epoch-59 sustained-turn evidence and the bounded-close control contradiction/correction into the canonical P001 baseline. Both boundaries are observed durable events; no later time is counted.

Validated the predecessor run and appended the first validity-aware operator review row. Both boundaries were directly observed around the durable commit; no surrounding bootstrap/control time is counted.

Implemented exact-second completion-relative due computation, added focused rollover/validation tests, made second precision an active lifecycle invariant, and integrated the new test into CI. Boundaries are adjacent observed progress boundaries; no later validation time is counted.

Implemented validity-aware review row generation, discovered and repaired prior no-op CI integration, verified all four tools are present in the workflow blob, and corrected the operator review with valid STARTUP-003 evidence. Boundaries are observed durable progress points.

Appended the second eligible turn review while preserving unknown successor claim/useful time and the separately observed 30-second delivery segment. Both boundaries were directly observed around the durable commit.

Implemented and tested missing-successor-progress diagnostics, exposed delivery and progress separately in generated reviews, repaired malformed CI command separators, and re-fetched the committed workflow to verify integration. Both time boundaries were directly observed; no surrounding time is inferred.

Added forward-only BOOT_STARTED and REARM_VERIFIED semantics, a distinct STARTUP_ACK_MISSING recovery class that does not pretend detection is recovery, and eight focused regression tests. Boundaries are observed authority claim and durable commit completion.

Implemented a fail-closed event-rescue decision engine for missing bootstrap acknowledgement, missing provisional rearm verification, and stale owners; gated emission on a verified consumer and no outstanding generation; wired the evaluator into CI and the inert rescue workflow; completed the initial three-turn evidence review. Both boundaries are observed and no wait time is counted.

Persisted the paired receipt-less normal generation and fixed-Watchdog recovery with explicit lineage and observed boundaries, then made the boundary audit include the active next_sample and added focused regression coverage. Eleven audit tests and the actual 12-sample ledger audit passed.

Specified and implemented an atomic close-state projection validator, added five discoverable regression tests, wired it into control-plane CI, and durably recorded the latest failed normal generation plus fixed-Watchdog recovery lineage. The actual 14-sample startup audit and all 88 discovered tests passed. Boundaries are observed authority claim and post-verification time; no later close work is counted.
